seo.title: Convert JFIF to JPEG Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert JFIF to JPEG in your browser. Each file is re-encoded as a standard JPEG at quality 0.85. Free, with no sign-up, and nothing is uploaded.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert JFIF to JPEG

tool.subtitle: Turn a .jfif file into a standard JPEG, right in your browser.

faqs.question: Is a JFIF file the same as a JPEG?
faqs.answer: Nearly. A .jfif file holds ordinary JPEG image data, and most programs read it like a regular JPEG. The extension is what some apps and sites don't accept.

faqs.question: Does converting JFIF to JPEG change the quality?
faqs.answer: Yes, slightly. The picture is decoded and written again as a JPEG at quality 0.85, so it is not a plain rename. JPEG is lossy, and a second save can lose a little detail.

faqs.question: Is my photo's EXIF data kept?
faqs.answer: No. Pixels are what pass through, so EXIF, ICC profiles and XMP are left behind. The new JPEG carries only the picture.

faqs.question: Can I change several JFIF files at once?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pick them together and the page works through them in order, saving each JPEG as a separate download.

fromFormat.name: JFIF
fromFormat.description: A container convention for JPEG-compressed images that specifies colour space and pixel aspect ratio. Files ending in .jfif contain ordinary JPEG image data.

toFormat.name: JPEG
toFormat.description: A lossy raster image format defined by the Joint Photographic Experts Group (ISO/IEC 10918-1), designed for photographs. .jpg and .jpeg are the same format.

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting JFIF to JPEG
points: The JPEG is written at quality 0.85, so the picture is re-encoded, not just renamed.
EXIF, ICC profile and XMP data are not carried over.
Neither format has transparency, so there is none to lose.
Several JFIF files give one JPEG each, downloaded separately.
Your original .jfif file isn't changed.

seo.title: Convert JPG to GIF Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert JPG to GIF in your browser. You get one GIF for each JPG, limited to 256 colours per frame. Free, with no sign-up, and nothing is uploaded.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert JPG to GIF

tool.subtitle: Save a JPG photo as a GIF image, right in your browser.

faqs.question: Will my JPG become an animated GIF?
faqs.answer: No. Each JPG is converted on its own into its own GIF. Several JPGs are never joined into one animation.

faqs.question: Why can a photo look different as a GIF?
faqs.answer: A GIF frame holds a palette of at most 256 colours, while a JPG photograph can use far more. Smooth gradients in a photo are the places that can change.

faqs.question: Is the JPG's metadata kept in the GIF?
faqs.answer: No. Only the picture is written, so the camera and colour-profile details stored in the JPG are not in the GIF.

faqs.question: Can I convert many JPG files at once?
faqs.answer: Yes. Select several JPGs and they are handled one after another. You download a separate GIF for each, with no ZIP.

fromFormat.name: JPG
fromFormat.description: A lossy raster image format defined by the Joint Photographic Experts Group (ISO/IEC 10918-1), designed for photographs. .jpg and .jpeg are the same format.

toFormat.name: GIF
toFormat.description: A raster image format introduced by CompuServe in 1987. It uses LZW compression, a palette of at most 256 colours per frame, and supports simple animation.

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting JPG to GIF
points: A GIF frame has at most 256 colours, so a photo may look different.
Each JPG gives one GIF; several JPGs are not combined into an animation.
EXIF, ICC profile and XMP data are not carried over.
A JPG has no transparency, so the GIF has none to keep.
Your original JPG isn't changed.

seo.title: Convert PSD to PDF Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert PSD to PDF in your browser. You get a one-page PDF the size of the image, with no layers. Free, with no sign-up, and nothing is uploaded.
seo.howToHeading: How to export PSD to PDF

tool.subtitle: Turn a Photoshop PSD file into a one-page PDF, right in your browser.

faqs.question: Do I need Photoshop to export a PSD to PDF?
faqs.answer: No. ImageMagick runs in your browser and reads the PSD, so nothing needs installing. You choose the file, then download the PDF.

faqs.question: Are the layers kept in the PDF?
faqs.answer: No. A layered PSD gives one picture, and the PDF holds that picture on a single page. The layers, masks and text of the PSD are not editable in the PDF.

faqs.question: How big is the PDF page?
faqs.answer: The single page matches the image, at one point per pixel. No margins are added, and the page isn't set to A4 or Letter.

faqs.question: Does the PDF keep transparent areas?
faqs.answer: Yes. No background colour is painted behind the picture, so clear pixels in the PSD's merged image remain clear in the PDF.

faqs.question: What if my PSD is very large?
faqs.answer: A picture over about 537 megapixels fails with a message that it is too large to convert here. Below that, there is no size limit of the page's own.

fromFormat.name: PSD
fromFormat.description: The native file format of Adobe Photoshop. It stores layers, masks, adjustment layers, text and colour information so a design can be edited later.

toFormat.name: PDF
toFormat.description: A document format created by Adobe in 1993 and standardized as ISO 32000. It keeps text, fonts, images and layout the same on any device.

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting PSD to PDF
points: The PSD becomes one picture, so layers are not kept.
The PDF has one page, the size of the image, with no margin.
The picture is embedded losslessly as a PNG.
Transparent pixels stay transparent in the PDF.
Several PSD files give one PDF each; they are never merged.

seo.title: Convert SVG to ICO Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert SVG to ICO in your browser. You get one icon image, fitted inside 256 x 256 if it is larger. Free, with no sign-up, and nothing is uploaded.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert SVG to ICO

tool.subtitle: Turn an SVG image into a Windows ICO icon, right in your browser.

faqs.question: Does the ICO hold several sizes?
faqs.answer: No. The ICO holds one image. The format can store several sizes in one file, but this page writes just one.

faqs.question: What size is the ICO?
faqs.answer: Your browser draws the SVG and reports its size, and the ICO uses that size. A side over 256 px is fitted inside 256 x 256 with the aspect ratio kept. A smaller image keeps its size.

faqs.question: Is the SVG still a vector in the ICO?
faqs.answer: No. The SVG is drawn to pixels first, so the ICO holds a bitmap. It does not scale like the SVG.

faqs.question: Can I use the ICO as a favicon?
faqs.answer: Browsers use ICO files for favicons, and this page makes a normal ICO. Since it holds one size, it suits a single icon size rather than a full set.

fromFormat.name: SVG
fromFormat.description: An XML-based vector image format and W3C standard. Shapes, paths and text are described mathematically, so images scale to any size without losing sharpness.

toFormat.name: ICO
toFormat.description: A container format for icons on Microsoft Windows that can hold several bitmap images of different sizes and colour depths in a single file. Browsers also use it for favicons.

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting SVG to ICO
points: The ICO holds one image, not a set of sizes.
An image with a side over 256 px is fitted inside 256 x 256, keeping its aspect ratio.
A 256 px image is stored as a PNG inside the ICO.
The SVG is turned into pixels, so the ICO is no longer a vector.
Several SVG files give one ICO each, downloaded separately.

seo.title: Convert DNG to JPG Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert DNG to JPG in your browser. Raw Digital Negative photos become one JPG each, ready to share. Free, with no sign-up, and nothing is uploaded.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert DNG to JPG

tool.subtitle: Turn a raw DNG photo into a JPG you can share, right in your browser.

faqs.question: What is a DNG file?
faqs.answer: DNG, short for Digital Negative, is an open raw image format that Adobe published in 2004. It holds unprocessed sensor data and is based on TIFF/EP.

faqs.question: Can I still edit the raw data in the JPG?
faqs.answer: No. A DNG holds unprocessed sensor data, and a JPG is a finished, lossy picture. Keep your DNG if you want to edit the raw data later.

faqs.question: Can I batch convert DNG to JPG?
faqs.answer: Yes. Select as many DNG files as you like in one go. They are processed in turn, and every JPG is saved separately without a ZIP.

faqs.question: Is there a file size limit?
faqs.answer: The page sets no limit on file size. A picture over about 537 megapixels fails with a message that it is too large to convert here.

fromFormat.name: DNG
fromFormat.description: An open raw image format published by Adobe in 2004 as a single documented alternative to the many proprietary raw formats. It is based on TIFF/EP.

toFormat.name: JPG
toFormat.description: A lossy raster image format defined by the Joint Photographic Experts Group (ISO/IEC 10918-1), designed for photographs. .jpg and .jpeg are the same format.

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting DNG to JPG
points: The JPG is a finished picture, so the raw sensor data is not kept.
JPG is lossy, so the result can't match everything in the DNG.
Each DNG gives one JPG; several files are not zipped.
A picture over about 537 megapixels is too large to convert here.
Your original DNG isn't changed.

seo.title: Convert WMA to MP3 Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert WMA to MP3 in your browser: the audio is re-encoded at 192 kbps with FFmpeg. Free, with no sign-up, and the file isn't uploaded.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert WMA to MP3

tool.subtitle: Turn a WMA audio file into a 192 kbps MP3, right in your browser.

faqs.question: What bitrate is the MP3?
faqs.answer: 192 kbps. FFmpeg re-encodes the WMA with the LAME encoder at that bitrate, and the page has no setting to change it.

faqs.question: Will the MP3 sound better than the WMA?
faqs.answer: No. Converting can't add quality the WMA doesn't have. Standard WMA is lossy and so is MP3, so the MP3 is at best as good as its source.

faqs.question: Is my WMA file uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. FFmpeg runs inside your browser, so the file stays on your device. A long file takes as long as your device needs.

faqs.question: Can I convert several WMA files at once?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose them together and FFmpeg works through them in turn. Every MP3 is its own download, not zipped.

fromFormat.name: WMA
fromFormat.description: A family of audio codecs developed by Microsoft and stored in the ASF container. The standard version is lossy, and a WMA Lossless variant exists.

toFormat.name: MP3
toFormat.description: A lossy audio format standardized by MPEG (ISO/IEC 11172-3), developed with major contributions from the Fraunhofer Society. It became the most common format for downloadable music.

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting WMA to MP3
points: The MP3 is encoded at 192 kbps.
The audio is re-encoded, so the MP3 can't be better than the WMA.
Converting several WMA files gives one MP3 for each.
FFmpeg runs in your browser, so the file isn't uploaded.
Your original WMA file isn't changed.

seo.description: Convert BMP to PDF in your browser. You get a one-page PDF the size of the image. Free, with no sign-up, and your file isn't uploaded.
seo.howToHeading: How do I convert BMP to PDF?

tool.subtitle: Turn a BMP image into a one-page PDF, right in your browser.

faqs.question: Can I put several BMP files into one PDF?
faqs.answer: No. Each BMP becomes its own PDF, and several files are never merged into one.

faqs.question: What size is the PDF page?
faqs.answer: One page, the size of the image: one pixel becomes one point, with no margin. It is not an A4 or Letter page.

faqs.question: Is the image quality kept in the PDF?
faqs.answer: The picture is embedded losslessly as a PNG, with no quality setting to lower. EXIF, ICC profile and XMP data are not carried over.

faqs.question: What happens to transparent areas?
faqs.answer: Nothing paints a background, so transparent pixels stay transparent in the PDF.

fromFormat.name: BMP
fromFormat.description: A raster image format introduced with Microsoft Windows that stores pixel data, usually uncompressed. It is simple to read and write but produces large files.

toFormat.name: PDF
toFormat.description: A document format created by Adobe in 1993 and standardized as ISO 32000. It keeps text, fonts, images and layout the same on any device.

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting BMP to PDF
points: The PDF has one page, the size of the image, with no margin.
The picture is embedded losslessly as a PNG.
Several BMP files give one PDF each; they are never merged.

seo.title: Convert JPEG to SVG Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert JPEG to SVG in your browser. The picture is embedded as an image, not traced to vector shapes. Free, with no sign-up, and nothing is uploaded.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert JPEG to SVG

tool.subtitle: Wrap a JPEG photo in an SVG file, right in your browser.

faqs.question: Does this turn my JPEG into vector shapes?
faqs.answer: No. The picture is not traced. The SVG holds a single image element with your picture embedded as a PNG, so it is still made of pixels.

faqs.question: Will the SVG scale without losing sharpness?
faqs.answer: No. The embedded picture keeps its pixel width and height, so it doesn't scale like a true vector. Enlarging it shows the same pixels bigger.

faqs.question: Is the picture reduced or resized?
faqs.answer: No. Nothing is resized or reduced. The full-colour picture is embedded as it is, at its own pixel width and height.

faqs.question: Is the photo's metadata inside the SVG?
faqs.answer: No. Only the picture is embedded, so EXIF, ICC profile and XMP details from the JPEG are not in the SVG.

fromFormat.name: JPEG
fromFormat.description: A lossy raster image format defined by the Joint Photographic Experts Group (ISO/IEC 10918-1), designed for photographs. .jpg and .jpeg are the same format.

toFormat.name: SVG
toFormat.description: An XML-based vector image format and W3C standard. Shapes, paths and text are described mathematically, so images scale to any size without losing sharpness.

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting JPEG to SVG
points: The JPEG is not traced: the SVG holds one embedded PNG image.
The embedded picture keeps its pixel width and height.
Nothing is resized or reduced.
EXIF, ICC profile and XMP data are not carried over.
Several JPEG files give one SVG each, downloaded separately.
